title: The Echo Canyon
synopsis: A deep red canyon, and the Hush walking the rim above the last train. It hears everything, so Rook gives it something to hear.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: Canyon run, passengers. Hold the bar.
Hear that? The walls sing our wheels back.
Something up there is eating the sound.
It hears everything. Let's give it a song.
Whistle! Long and loud, into that wall!
Wait... where did it go? Under the arch!
...Our echo. It's still singing out there.
Now. Quiet wheels, then full steam.
It will be back. It always is.
Thank you, canyon. Sing for us again.
